description: This source file defines a Java servlet filter class named TokenFilter which intercepts HTTP requests to handle JWT token validation, user session management, and error responses within the Apache OFBiz web application framework.

classes.name: TokenFilter
classes.description: A servlet filter implementing the javax.servlet.Filter interface, used to validate JWT tokens on incoming HTTP requests, manage user sessions, and handle error responses.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the filter with the given configuration.

methods.name: doFilter
methods.description: Processes incoming requests, extracts JWT token, validates it, retrieves user info, manages session attributes, and handles error responses or passes request along the chain.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Cleans up resources allocated during filter lifecycle.
